warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Door widths: where two widths are printed (0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Every door is 2.05 high to ระดับพื้นห้อง; the 2.05 on ป1 is partly cut at the sheet edge and read with the others (lower confidence).
